bundle.shortDescription: PaperStack - local-first, read-only Markdown and math reader
bundle.longDescription:
PaperStack is a Linux-first, local-first read-only reader for technical documents.
Version 0.1.0 renders Markdown with math (KaTeX), Mermaid diagrams and Shiki-highlighted code, fully offline from local files.
